name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 3 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2025-12-16, at wavelengths from 1.35 to 4.70 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
